scope: single GCP Certification Practice wrong-option diagnostic and adjacent Details in native Q12 presentation capture

finding.message: This option selects at the billing account, but the decisive requirement is organization-wide attachment scope.
finding.observed: In both light and dark captures, the last visible line ends at “organization-wide attachme…” at the right edge. The final letters and punctuation are absent from the visible diagnostic row.
finding.impact: The learner cannot visually read the complete authored explanation for the selected wrong choice at a supported large-text setting. A later boundary detail repeats the phrase and partly mitigates comprehension loss, but does not make this message readable.
finding.requirement: Q12 native-presentation brief requires a readable authored diagnostic and complete Details. Design-system Accessibility baseline requires dynamic text sizing without clipped essential content. Authored choice explanations are preserved by stable option ID under the training interaction contract.
finding.recommendation: Make this React Native Text wrap completely within the available width at this supported font scale. Preserve the canonical authored text and stable-ID mapping; do not shorten or replace the explanation.
finding.acceptance: On the same saved wrong-answer review item in both themes at the same supported capped size, the entire message including “attachment scope.” appears over wrapped lines with no horizontal overflow; adjacent Details and navigation remain reachable.
preserve: authored message text/order and stable option ID

sourceBindings.location: line 33 message and detail render; line 41 shared detailText style

finding.causeEvidence: The message and adjacent detail use the same Text component/style and font cap; the source has no explicit message-only numberOfLines or ellipsizeMode. The boundary detail wraps while the diagnostic line clips. Source alone does not explain the difference.
finding.nextProbe: Optional cause-diagnosis probe, not a new acceptance gate: on the same item and size, inspect native accessibility/layout frames for the message Text and following detail Text, comparing right bounds and complete labels. If hierarchy output lacks per-line geometry, a narrowly scoped test-only onTextLayout probe could record line widths. The existing Q12 visual retest is sufficient to accept a correction.

additionalScreenCheck.result: The right-hand zero values in Partly correct and Unanswered outcome cards appear fully visible with card margins; no additional confirmed clipping finding.
